name: notify-ntfy
description: Send a phone notification through an ntfy server (ntfy.sh or one you run). INPUT (the same for every notify-* adapter): the node before this one returns `notification: {title?, body, priority?: low|normal|high, tag?, link?, actions?: [{title, link, one_tap?}]}`; `skip: true` sends nothing. Links must be https; anything else is not sent and is counted. At most 3 actions. OUTPUT (the same for every adapter): {provider, sent, skipped, dry_run, status, actions_sent, actions_dropped, one_tap_actions, link_sent, link_dropped, tag_sent}. To change service, swap this module on the send node (swap_node_module) and set the other adapter's config; nothing upstream changes. See docs/notification-contract.md. WHAT NTFY DOES WITH IT: priority low/normal/high is sent as 2/3/4; `link` is what a tap opens; an action marked one_tap is sent as a background POST, so a Talos action link acts on ONE tap with no page to confirm; other actions open their link; `tag` is not sent (tag_sent is false). A response that is not 2xx fails the node with the host and the status, never the body. GRANTS: installs with NO allowed hosts and no secrets, so it can reach nothing until you say what it may reach: set the server's host with update_module_hosts and the token's exact path with update_module_secrets. Use one installed copy per server. CREDENTIALS: the module never holds one; AUTH_HEADER carries a vault:// reference the host replaces when the request is sent.

SERVER_URL.description: The ntfy server's https:// address, for example https://ntfy.sh.

TOPIC.description: The topic to publish to: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '_' or '-'. On a public server a topic name is the only thing keeping it private; pick one that cannot be guessed, or use a token.

AUTH_HEADER.description: Optional. 'Bearer vault://ntfy/token' for a server or topic that needs a token. Omit for an open topic.

DRY_RUN.description: true: check the notification and the config, send nothing, and report what would be sent.

setup_instructions.title: Subscribe on the phone
setup_instructions.detail: Install the ntfy app and subscribe to your topic on your server.

setup_instructions.title: Store the token
setup_instructions.detail: If the server or topic needs a token, store it in the vault (Settings, or the secrets mutation) under ntfy/token. Tokens are not stored through MCP.

setup_instructions.title: Grant the installed copy
setup_instructions.detail: update_module_hosts with the server's host; update_module_secrets with ntfy/token.

setup_instructions.title: Rehearse
setup_instructions.detail: Set DRY_RUN true and read the result: it reports what would be sent, and sends nothing.
